newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest warns of pre-tax Dec qtr loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest warns of pre-tax Dec qtr loss.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Wednesday it would record a pre-tax unaudited loss before abnormals of A$4.8 million for the December quarter 1996.
It was also expected that the company might only record a breakeven position in the second half to June 1997, Newcrest said in its quarterly report to December 31.
Newcrest said the second quarter was severely impacted by an unexpected decline in the oxide mill feed grade at its Telfer mine in Western Australia.
It was anticipated that the lower grade oxide mill feed would continue for the remainder of the 1996/97 year, it said.
Newcrest also warned of a potential write-down of its stake in Normandy Mining Ltd in its half-year financial results, due on February 27.
"This result will include the determination of the appropriate carrying value of the Normandy investment taking account of the significant fall in market value," Newcrest said.
Newcrest said in October it was carrying a paper loss of A$107 million from its A$450 million investment in Normandy.
Normandy's share price at the time was about A$1.77, valuing Newcrest's holding at A$341.7 million, but has sinced eased to around A$1.61.
This would value Newcrest's holding at A$310.8 million, a paper loss of nearly A$140 million.
A decision to write down the holding indicated Newcrest planned to hold on to the Normandy stake and intended to carry it a realistic value, a gold analyst said.
Newcrest said group equity gold production in the December quarter was 129,121 ounces, down 3.3 percent on the previous corresponding quarter.
Cost of production rose 6.5 percent to A$411 per ounce.
